subject: zot
title: Shipped default binds nothing: yolo + jail-off + no OS layer; headless modes void the opt-in silently
one_why: Approval (args.go:236 --no-yolo) and path jail (jail_by_default) are both opt-in and default-off, and -p/--json/rpc modes ignore --no-yolo entirely (args.go:102-105) so scripted runs get free-running tools with only a stderr warning; nanocoder/octomind shipped-default doctrine third application - real tested machinery + wrong default = rung 5, honest labeling earns the 5 not a 4

subject: zot
title: Substring bash deny-list is deny-by-literal: bypassable by construction, weaker than the regex cluster
one_why: strings.Contains over literals like "rm -rf /" and "sudo " (lowercased) - whitespace variants, quoting ('rm' -rf /), $IFS, and env expansion bypass trivially, and only the first ;-segment's cd target is checked; the corpus's regex-denylist x15 has at least pattern anchors - a bare-substring matcher is a new floor for the family; code self-labels 'a speed bump, not a security boundary' (:131), honest but unenforceable

subject: zot
title: Anthropic OAuth mode impersonates Claude Code's first-party identity line to ride subscription auth
one_why: claudeCodeIdentity = "You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude." is mandatorily prepended in OAuth mode - comment states Anthropic 'rejects' (429) requests without it, i.e. the identity string is a server-side admission check being spoofed; grinta's rival-subscription-transport taxonomy question (ToS-risk vs license-risk) now applies to same-vendor first-party impersonation, a sharper variant

subject: zot
title: Digest-keyed consent receipts for zotfile agents: config edits invalidate consent, fail-closed
one_why: Consent stored at ZotHome/agents/<name>/consents/<digest>.json keyed on the zotfile digest (:813,843) so any manifest change requires fresh approval, "ask" mode demands per-launch consent (:810-811), and refusal is fail-closed ('refusing to run without interactive consent' :827) - the countermeasure the clone-and-run family (memcode/waveloom/zap x3+) lacks, and a step beyond mocode's hash-gated skill trust (receipt durability + per-launch mode); hotdog-fit for workspace-sourced config

subject: zot
title: 7,820-LOC interactive.go fuses view cache, keymap, dialogs, and settings - ERRATA >5k dock applied 8->7
one_why: The core/product split itself is correct (runLoop in core/agent.go:446, modes/ are consumers) - it is the single TUI-mode file at 7.8k LOC, 2.9x the frozen ERRATA docking threshold and larger than the 7.8k/6.8k files that made pi's 9 'the study's most fragile rung'; fusion is view/input/settings not loop/policy, which floors it at 7 rather than crush's 7-with-fused-loop
